model_set_name.description: 6. Multi-model outputs | Registered MODEL SET name (not a table). Blank = <project_name>_set; enter your own name to override. Target catalog/metadata schema and dev suffix are added automatically

model_set_promotion_policy.description: 6. Model set lifecycle | manual_approval = review then approve; automatic = activate the complete set only when EVERY branch passes its saved quality_threshold, additional quality_gates and improvement over its counterpart in the current champion set. Configure metrics in multi_model.py. First sets require absolute thresholds. Score runs separately

model_set_output_mode.description: 6. Multi-model outputs | all = save every model prediction and business result together; combined_only = run the models but save only combined business results plus keys/status/version (requires rules); separate_views = save all results once and expose model/business columns through separately named views, without duplicate tables

model_set_table_name.description: 6. Multi-model outputs | Physical result table name. Blank = <project_name>_set_scores. Target catalog/schema and dev suffix are added automatically

model_view_prefix.description: 6. Multi-model outputs | Prefix for each model view: <prefix>_<branch>. Blank = <project_name>_predictions. Customize individual names or select models in config/inference.yml (model_set)

combined_view_name.description: 6. Multi-model outputs | Combined business result view name. Blank = <project_name>_business_results. Created only when the saved set has combined rules

source_change_policy.description: 6. Multi-model outputs | If existing source rows are updated/deleted: reject = stop and keep previous results; rebuild_on_change = rescore the full current snapshot with the selected model set, rebuilding lag/rolling history. New inserts still append. Full data must fit row/byte limits. Independent of the model-change setting
